repository_roots.note: Deliberately not a member of the root workspace; isolates the Tauri host's tokio/reqwest deps from the kernel crates (ADR-004).

rust.toolchain_pin: rust-toolchain.toml channel=1.92.0 (components: rustfmt, clippy, profile: minimal)

python.use: auxiliary scripts only (UI-kit generators, skill validators); not a product language in this repo

package_managers.name: devbox
package_managers.scope: system tools (git, rustup, just, direnv, sops, age, gitleaks, cargo-deny)

applications.name: sea-forge-desktop
applications.binary: Tauri 2 bundle (dev: bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri dev)

services.name: sea-forge-server
services.smoke_test_evidence: Live system_hello response observed 2026-07-27; see VERIFICATION_BASELINE.md V-SMOKE-1.

libraries.name: sea-forge-core
libraries.role: kernel types, ID grammar, errors, approvals fold

libraries.name: sea-forge-settlement
libraries.role: outcome evaluation, declarations, SWE_SEED claim manifests

libraries.name: sea-forge-capability
libraries.role: capability envelope, promotion, SQLite-indexed capability memory

libraries.name: sea-forge-ledger
libraries.role: ULID ledger streams, hash chains, MMR commitments

libraries.name: sea-forge-workbench (Tauri host)
libraries.role: closed typed SFWP bridge to the renderer

interfaces.name: SFWP (SEA Forge Workbench Protocol)
interfaces.versioning_policy: major-only accept; unknown verb fails clean (serde unknown-variant), no panic

interfaces.name: Tauri command bridge
interfaces.rule: no generic invoke_backend escape hatch; mirrors server Request variants byte-for-byte

apis.name: SFWP (primary external API)
apis.auth_model: filesystem permissions on socket; no in-protocol auth

apis.name: AgentProvider HTTP
apis.auth_model: credential from secret allowlist, Zeroizing<String>; never inherited ambient

apis.name: ACP (Agent Client Protocol) v1
apis.transport: NDJSON JSON-RPC over child process stdio
apis.auth_model: ACP permission requests mediated as SEA approval decisions

data_stores.name: ledger streams
data_stores.kind: ULID-keyed JSONL with hash chains and MMR commitments

data_stores.name: capability SQLite index
data_stores.path: rebuilt projection; rebuildable from append-only source

data_stores.name: Tauri host draft storage
data_stores.kind: versioned local JSON files in app_data_dir/drafts/

entry_points: Tauri desktop (workbench/apps/desktop: bun run tauri dev|build)
Vite renderer dev server (workbench: bun run dev)
